source.source: Community-measured LiPo voltage-vs-SOC charts (intofpv.com LiPo voltage quick chart; usedbytes.com measured discharge profile). OCV curve per cell; sag from pack internal resistance handled separately.
source.notes: OCV-SOC shape is generic LiPo chemistry behavior. Capacity (22 Ah), mass (5.8 kg) and internal resistance (18 mOhm pack) are TYPICAL values for a 12S 22 Ah 25C-class pack: flagged estimated with wide uncertainty and must be replaced with the specific pack's datasheet/measurements for credible endurance numbers.
